text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Arima Kinen.
Gold City
shrugs off compliments about
her looks with an
air of resignation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Тамамо Кросс appears
ecstatic in the
paddock. This is the
showdown she's been
craving. But after
seeing Голд Сити's lack of
motivation,
she grows irritated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити heads into the race all the
same,
believing that just maybe there's
still a chance her
reputation can be
changed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
